# How Do I Connect an Uploaded Document to Automatic Data Extraction?


You connect a document to automatic extraction by uploading it directly to a table configured with Image Reader, letting AI extract key fields without any manual typing. On **Jestor** , this runs through **Image Reader (OCR)** .


Manually typing data from an uploaded document, like an invoice or contract, into structured fields is repetitive work that also risks a transcription error on important details.


## What manual document data entry costs


- Time spent retyping the same categories of information from every document
- Risk of a transcription error on financially or legally significant fields
- Staff time spent on data entry instead of higher-value review and exceptions
- Processing delays when document volume is unusually high


## How automatic document data extraction works


- The document, invoice, contract, or receipt, is uploaded directly to a **table**
- **Image Reader (OCR)** extracts key fields automatically upon upload
- Extracted data populates the record without manual typing
- Staff review the extraction rather than typing every field from scratch


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Automatic extraction removes the bulk of repetitive manual data entry
- This reduces the risk of typos on financially or legally significant fields
- Staff time shifts from data entry toward higher-value review work
- This scales from occasional documents to a high volume of uploads


Manual document typing Automatic OCR extraction


Repetitive, risk of error Extracted automatically


## Frequently Asked Questions


**What kind of documents does this extraction handle well?** Invoices, contracts, receipts, and similar structured documents typically work well. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does extracted data still need a quick human review?** A quick review is recommended, though extraction is generally accurate.


**Can this extraction feed directly into an approval workflow?** Yes, extracted data can flow directly into a connected approval process.
